patchName: Patch 2.2.23 — Popol and Kupa Revamp (Original Server)
source: MLBB Plus local data, updated to Patch 2.2.23 (Nov 11, 2026 Original Server). Item stats cross-checked vs MLBB in-game patch notes via Kazuki Official / mlbb.tools / timesaver.gg mirror, and MLBBGuides item DB (Nov 1, 2026) + MLBB Draft / Fandom. Item IDs are stable MLBB Plus IDs (1000 Attack, 2000 Magic, 3000 Defense, 4000 Roam, 5000 Movement, 6000 Jungle/Magic) because Moonton does not publish a public official numeric item ID like hero IDs. Use this ID as primary key.
patchChanges: Chastise Pauldron (3009) NERFED: Chastise 75% -> 80% (attackers keep more Attack Speed)
Antique Cuirass (3003) BUFFED: Deter 6% -> 8% per stack
Twilight Armor (3007) REMOVED — replaced by Chastise Pauldron

All other items: stats, prices, passives and descriptions corrected to Nov 2026 values (many were pre-2024 values in 2.2.23 file, e.g. Demon Hunter Sword, Endless Battle, Blade Armor, Guardian Helmet, Winter Crown, Starlium Scythe)

schema.id: Stable MLBB Plus item ID. Heroes.json coreItems and coreBuild reference this ID.
schema.name: Official in-game item name
schema.category: Attack / Magic / Defense / Movement / Roam / Jungle
schema.stats: Display strings for Items screen — shown as bullet list
schema.statsDetailed: Structured stats for future filtering / comparison
schema.passive/active: Passive and Active effects, or null if none
schema.buildPath: Component item names — shown as Build Path in Detail
schema.counters/counteredBy: Item IDs that counter / are countered by this item

items.name: Blade of Despair

passive.name: Despair
passive.description: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2 seconds (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.description: The highest Physical Attack item in the game. Core finisher for burst marksmen and assassins who want to snowball low-HP targets. The +5% Movement Speed helps chase and reposition.
items.lore: A blade that thirsts for despair.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword

passive.name: Engulf / Devour
passive.description: Engulf: Basic Attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as extra Physical Damage (capped at 60 against minions). Devour: Each Basic Attack recovers 10 (+4*Hero Level) HP. This effect is halved against minions.

items.description: The premier anti-tank marksman item. Percentage current-HP damage shreds high-HP fighters and tanks, while Devour gives sustain in extended trades. Core vs Gloo, Masha, Belerick and other high-HP frontlines.
items.lore: "A blade with its core carved from the bones of an Iceland Golem, the power that resides within almost seems to impart the fierce history of those giants in the time before they were slain."

items.name: Berserker's Fury

passive.name: Doom
passive.description: Crits deal +40% extra damage. Critical strikes grant an extra 5% Physical Attack for 2 seconds.

items.description: Core crit item for marksmen. The +40% Crit Damage makes every crit hit much harder, and the short Physical Attack buff on crit rewards aggressive trading. Best paired with Windtalker and Haas's Claws.

items.name: Malefic Roar

passive.name: Armor Buster / Breaker
passive.description: Armor Buster: Increase Physical Penetration by 30%. Breaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 30%.

items.description: The anti-tank penetration item. Scales against high-Defense targets, so it gets stronger the tankier the enemy is. Essential vs Defense-heavy teams stacking Blade Armor, Antique Cuirass and Dominance Ice.

items.name: Wind of Nature

active.name: Wind Chant
active.description: Become immune to all Physical Damage for 2 seconds (duration is halved if Main Role is not Marksman; 90 seconds cooldown).

items.description: Defensive active for marksmen vs burst physical damage. Time it against Saber, Hayabusa, Lancelot or Moskov ultimates to survive the burst and turn the fight.

items.name: Blade of Heptaseas

passive.name: Ambush
passive.description: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5 seconds (excluding from Minions or Creeps), the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 160 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

items.description: Burst for assassins and poke fighters. The Ambush proc rewards roaming and bush play — open from stealth or after rotating for a huge slow + burst.

items.name: Hunter Strike

passive.name: Retribution
passive.description: Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row grants 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds (8 seconds cooldown).

items.description: Chase and CDR for fighters and assassins. The Movement Speed burst after 5 hits lets you stick to fleeing targets or disengage after a trade.

items.name: Endless Battle

passive.name: Divine Justice
passive.description: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals (60% Total Physical Attack) extra True Damage and recovers 80 (+40% of Total Physical Attack) HP (1.5 seconds cooldown).

items.description: Hybrid sustain + True Damage for skill-based fighters and assassins. Weave skill -> Basic Attack to proc Divine Justice for True Damage that ignores Defense, plus a heal. Core on Roger, Alucard, Bane and other skill-weaving fighters.

items.name: Windtalker

passive.name: Typhoon
passive.description: Every 5-2 seconds (reduced by 0.2 seconds for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150-362 Magic Damage. This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.

items.description: Attack Speed + wave clear + splash for marksmen. Typhoon procs clear waves fast and poke in teamfights. Pairs with Berserker's Fury for crit splash damage.

items.name: Malefic Gun

passive.name: Armor Buster / Malefic Energy
passive.description: Armor Buster: Increase Physical Penetration by 30%. Malefic Energy: Increases Basic Attack range by 12%. When hitting a target, gains 10% Movement Speed for 0.5 seconds.

items.description: Range + penetration for marksmen. The +12% range lets you kite from outside enemy threat range, and the Move Speed on hit helps reposition. Core on Karrie, Moskov, Claude and other range-dependent marksmen in 2.2.23.

items.name: Corrosion Scythe

passive.name: Corrosive / Impulse
passive.description: Corrosive: Basic Attacks gain 80 extra Physical Damage and slow the target by 8% (halved for ranged Basic Attacks) for 1.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times. Impulse: Basic Attacks grant 6% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds, capped at 5 stacks.

items.description: Slow + shred for kiting marksmen. Stacking slows and Attack Speed make it hard for enemies to escape. Great on Popol and Kupa, Karrie and Wanwan in 2.2.23.
items.lore: Corrosion eats away at armor and hope.

items.name: Golden Staff

passive.name: Swift / Endless Strike
passive.description: Swift: Every 1% extra Crit Chance gained is converted into 1% extra Attack Speed. Endless Strike: After every 2 non-Crit Basic Attacks, the Attack Speed of the next Basic Attack is increased by 80% (and Attack Speed cap is increased to 500%) and triggers Attack Effects an additional 2 time(s).

items.description: Stacking Attack Speed for DPS marksmen who rely on Attack Effects (Karrie, Claude, Moskov). Converts Crit Chance into Attack Speed, so build it with items that give Crit Chance but don't want to crit.

items.name: Haas's Claws

passive.name: Frenzy
passive.description: Critical strikes grant 20% extra Attack Speed for 2 seconds.

items.description: The lifesteal + crit hybrid for marksmen. High Lifesteal keeps you in fights, Crit Chance + Frenzy Attack Speed spikes your DPS. Core on Bruno, Granger and other crit marksmen who need sustain.

items.name: War Axe

passive.name: Fighting Spirit
passive.description: Attacks grant 12 extra Physical Attack per second for 4 seconds, up to 6 stacks. Deals 10% extra True Damage based on the damage dealt (no damage reduction counted) at full stacks. (Marksmen, Mages, and Supports only receive 50% of these stacked effects.)

items.description: Brawler sustain for fighters. Stacks Physical Attack in extended fights and converts damage to True Damage at full stacks. Best on fighters who stay in fights — Yu Zhong, Lukas, Paquito, Lapu-Lapu.
items.lore: An axe forged for endless war.

items.name: Sea Halberd

passive.name: Lifebane / Punish
passive.description: Lifebane: Dealing damage to a target will reduce the Shield and HP Regen effects on them to 60% of normal for 3 seconds. Punish: Increase damage by 8% against enemy heroes with higher extra HP.

items.description: Anti-heal for marksmen vs Estes, Rafaela, Floryn, Yu Zhong and high-regen comps. Also punishes high-HP tanks. Build it when the enemy has 2+ healers or heavy HP Regen.
items.lore: A halberd that stops the tide of healing.

items.name: Sky Piercer

passive.name: Lethality
passive.description: After dealing damage to an enemy hero, executes the hero if their HP is lower than 4%. Gains 10 stack(s) of Lethality for each kill and loses 30% current stack(s) for each death. Each stack of Lethality increases the HP threshold of the execute effect by 0.1%, stacking up 80 times.

items.description: Execute for assassins and finishers. The Lethality stacks snowball — the more kills you get, the higher the execute threshold. High risk, high reward: deaths lose stacks.
items.lore: Pierce the sky, finish the hunt.

items.name: Lightning Truncheon

passive.name: Resonate
passive.description: Every 6 seconds, the next skill echoes, dealing 255 (+85% Magic Power) extra Magic Damage to all enemies in range.

items.description: Core burst mage item. Resonate adds AoE burst to every rotation, especially strong in teamfights where enemies clump. Core on Xavier, Lunox, Kagura and most burst mages.

items.name: Holy Crystal

passive.name: Mystery
passive.description: Increases Magic Power by 21%-35% (scales with hero level).

items.description: Highest Magic Power scaling. Late-game mage core — the percentage Magic Power boost gets stronger as you level and as you stack other Magic Power items. Build it 3rd-4th when you have a Magic Power base to multiply.

items.name: Genius Wand

passive.name: Magic
passive.description: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 2.5+(0.5*Hero Level) for 2 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.

items.description: Magic penetration + shred for mages. Stacking Magic Defense reduction makes your whole team’s magic damage hit harder. Core vs teams stacking Athena's Shield / Radiant Armor.

items.name: Glowing Wand

passive.name: Scorch / Lifebane
passive.description: Scorch: Dealing Magic Damage burns the targets for 3 seconds, also dealing extra Magic Damage equal to 1% of the target's Max HP per second. Lifebane: Dealing damage to the target will reduce the Shield and HP Regen effects on them to 60% of normal for 3 seconds.

items.description: Burn + anti-heal for poke mages. Scorch shreds tanks with Max HP burn, Lifebane cuts healing from Estes, Rafaela and lifesteal heroes. Core on Valir, Lylia, Chang'e and other poke mages.
items.lore: A wand that glows with burning spite.

items.name: Blood Wings

passive.name: Guard
passive.description: Gains a 800 (+100% Magic Power) Shield that will regenerate 20 seconds after being damaged. The Shield also grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts and 150 Movement Speed for 1 second after it breaks.

items.description: Tanky mage late game. The large shield + Move Speed lets squishy mages survive dives and reposition. Pair with Holy Crystal for the biggest late-game Magic Power + shield combo.
items.lore: Wings of blood, shield of magic.

items.name: Winter Crown

active.name: Frozen
active.description: Becomes frozen, untargetable, and immune to damage for 2 seconds (100 seconds cooldown). Cannot move or cast skills while frozen, but skills already cast won't be interrupted.

items.description: Mage defensive active — like Wind of Nature for mages. Freeze to dodge Saber/Lancelot/Hayabusa burst, wait for cooldowns, or stall while your ultimate ticks. Use it after casting your combo so damage keeps ticking while you're untargetable.
items.lore: Frozen in winter, safe from harm.

items.name: Blade Armor

passive.name: Bladed Armor
passive.description: When struck by a Basic Attack, deals Physical Damage equal to 30 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% of the incoming damage (calculated before Damage Reduction) to the attacker and slows them by 15% for 1 second.

items.description: Anti-crit / anti-marksman armor. Reflects Basic Attack damage back and slows the attacker. Core vs Bruno, Moskov, Miya, Claude and other Basic Attack marksmen. In 2.2.23 it remains the best answer to crit marksmen.
items.lore: Armor with blades — hurt the attacker.

items.name: Dominance Ice

passive.name: Fortress Shield / Lifebane
passive.description: Fortress Shield: For each enemy hero within 5 units, Hybrid Defense is increased by 8, up to 40. Lifebane: Reduces Shield and HP Regen effects of nearby enemies within 5 units to 60% of normal for 1 second.

items.description: Anti-attack-speed + anti-heal aura. Must-have vs marksmen and high-heal comps. The Hybrid Defense aura scales in teamfights when multiple enemies are near you.

items.name: Antique Cuirass

passive.name: Deter
passive.description: When hit by a skill, reduces the attacker's Physical Damage by 8% for 2 seconds (this effect stacks up to 3 times). [BUFFED in Patch 2.2.23: 6% -> 8%]

items.description: Anti-burst physical armor. BUFFED in Patch 2.2.23 — Deter now reduces attacker's Physical Damage by 8% per stack (was 6%), up to 24% total. Now the best physical defense vs skill-burst heroes like Saber, Lancelot and Paquito, and it finally competes with Chastise Pauldron.

items.name: Athena's Shield

passive.name: Shield
passive.description: Upon taking Magic Damage from enemy hero skills or Basic Attacks, reduces Magic Damage taken by 25% for 3 seconds (including the damage that triggers the effect). Regains this effect 5 seconds after leaving combat.

items.description: Core magic defense vs burst mages. The 25% Magic Damage reduction on first hit blunts Eudora, Xavier, Lunox and Kagura burst. Build it when enemy mage is fed.
items.lore: Shield of Athena, guardian against magic.

items.name: Radiant Armor

passive.name: Holy Blessing
passive.description: Taking Magic Damage grants 5 (+1*Hero Level) Magic Defense for 5 seconds, up to 6 stacks (can only gain 1 stack(s) every 0.4 seconds).

items.description: Anti-poke magic armor vs sustained magic damage. Stacks Magic Defense the longer you take magic damage — best vs Chang'e, Lylia, Valir, Yve and other poke mages. Use Radiant for poke, Athena's for burst.

items.name: Immortality

passive.name: Immortal
passive.description: Resurrect 2.5 seconds upon death and gets 16% Max HP and a shield that can absorb 150 (+70*Hero Level) damage. Shield lasts 3 seconds. This effect has a 210 seconds cooldown.

items.description: Second life. Core for Roam / initiators and late-game carries. Revive to turn a lost teamfight, bait enemies into overcommitting, or survive to finish an objective.

items.name: Twilight Armor

passive.name: Twilight (Legacy)
passive.description: REMOVED in current patch. Previously: Capped damage from a single hit. This item no longer exists in the shop in Patch 2.2.23.

items.description: LEGACY / REMOVED — Twilight Armor was replaced by Chastise Pauldron (ID 3009) in the current item system. Kept in this file for backwards compatibility with old builds. Do not show in shop. Use Chastise Pauldron instead.

items.name: Guardian Helmet

passive.name: Recovery / Defender
passive.description: Recovery: After 5 seconds out of combat, recover (2.5% Total HP) HP per second. Defender: Upon taking more than 500 damage in a single instance, recover 30 (+0.3% Total HP)% HP from the excess damage beyond that amount.

items.description: Sustain tank helmet. The highest HP item + out-of-combat regen lets tanks stay on the map without recalling. Best on high-HP tanks like Hylos, Belerick, Gloo and Baxia.
items.lore: A helmet that guards and heals.

items.name: Chastise Pauldron

passive.name: Chastise / Redemption
passive.description: Chastise: Taking damage will reduce the Attack Speed and Attack Speed cap of the attacker to 80% of normal for 2 seconds. [NERFED in Patch 2.2.23: 75% -> 80%]. Redemption: When incoming damage reduces HP below 30%, recover 20% Max HP over the next 2 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.

items.description: Anti-Attack Speed armor. NERFED in Patch 2.2.23 — attackers now keep 80% of their Attack Speed (was 75%), so it's less oppressive vs Attack Speed heroes. Still strong vs Moskov, Miya, Claude and other Attack Speed marksmen, but Antique Cuirass (buffed to 8%) now competes for the slot. Replaces Twilight Armor.
items.lore: Chastise those who strike too fast.
items.patchChange: NERFED: Chastise 75% -> 80% (attackers keep more Attack Speed)

items.name: Fleeting Time

passive.name: Timestream
passive.description: After killing or assisting in killing an enemy hero, reduces the cooldown of your hero's Ultimate by 30%.

items.description: Ultimate spam for supports, Roam and ultimate-dependent heroes. Every kill/assist refunds 30% of your Ultimate cooldown, so you can use game-changing ultimates much more often. Core on Estes, Angela, Mathilda, Tigreal and other Roam initiators.
items.lore: Time flows faster for the swift.

items.name: Flask of the Oasis

passive.name: Blessing
passive.description: When casting a healing or shield skill, if the target's HP is below 35%, or falls below 35% within 3 seconds, they will get a (100*Hero Level) shield that lasts 3 seconds. When this effect triggers, it also reduces the cooldown of the caster's skills by 2 seconds. (This effect can only trigger once every 60 seconds on the same target, and will not trigger on self-only healing and shield skills.)

items.description: Healer support item. Amplifies healing/shielding and adds an emergency shield when allies drop low. Core on Estes, Floryn, Rafaela, Angela and other healers.
items.lore: An oasis in the desert of battle.

items.name: Courage Mask

passive.name: Thriving / Devotion
passive.description: Roam Blessing item. Heroes with this Blessing gain EXP and Gold by dealing damage to enemy heroes or revealing enemies. Unlocks Encourage active after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving and Devotion.

active.name: Encourage
active.description: Grants nearby allied heroes bonus Adaptive Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration. Use before engaging to boost your team's damage.

items.description: Roam Blessing — Encourage. Team buff active for Roamers who want to boost their team's damage on engage. Pick Encourage when your team has 2+ damage dealers who benefit from the Attack buff. In-game this is a Roam Blessing, not a standalone shop item — you pick it via the Roam boots path.

items.name: Favor

passive.name: Favor
passive.description: Every 15 seconds, the next healing or shield skill recovers an extra 400 HP for the allied hero with the lowest HP (including self) within 5 units. Skills that only take effect on self cannot trigger this effect. Heroes with this Blessing can gain 35% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps when allied heroes are nearby or by revealing enemy vision. Unlocks after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving and Devotion.

items.description: Passive heal Roam Blessing. Best for healers and shielders — Estes, Floryn, Rafaela, Angela, Mathilda. The periodic 400 HP heal adds up in lane and teamfights.
items.lore: Favor of the team, healing for all.

items.name: Swift Boots
items.description: Attack Speed boots for marksmen and Basic Attack fighters. Best when you need Attack Speed early and the enemy has little CC or magic burst.

items.name: Warrior Boots

passive.name: Valor
passive.description: Taking Physical Damage increases Physical Defense. Stacks up to 5 times.

items.description: Physical Defense boots. Default vs physical-heavy enemy teams (marksman + assassin + fighter). The stacking Physical Defense makes you tankier the longer you are hit.

items.name: Tough Boots

passive.name: Fortitude
passive.description: Reduces the duration of Crowd Control effects by 30%.

items.description: Anti-CC boots vs mages and CC-heavy teams. The 30% CC reduction is huge vs Eudora, Aurora, Tigreal, Atlas and other CC chains. Default pick when enemy has 2+ CC heroes.

items.name: Magic Shoes
items.description: CDR boots for mages and supports. Best when you need your skills up more often and the enemy has low burst. Core on most mages and CDR supports.

items.name: Rapid Boots

passive.name: Side Effect
passive.description: Loses 20 Movement Speed for 5 seconds upon dealing or taking damage.

items.description: Roam speed boots for fast rotations. The +65 Movement Speed is the highest in the game, perfect for Roamers who need to gank and rotate. Loses speed in combat, so it's for map movement, not fighting.

items.name: Starlium Scythe

passive.name: Crisis
passive.description: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 90 (+60% Total Magic Power) extra True Damage and reduces the target's Movement Speed by 15% for 1.5 seconds (1.5 seconds cooldown).

items.description: Enhanced Basic Attacks for mage junglers and skill-weaving mages. The True Damage proc + slow rewards skill -> Basic Attack weaving. Core on Harith, Lunox, Julian, Guinevere and mage Junglers. In 2.2.23 it is a Magic item (not a Jungle-only item) — usable in Mid and Jungle.
